# Image Compressor Pro

> Free online image compressor powered by Node.js and Sharp. Compress up to 20 images at once with adjustable quality, real-time size preview, and zero disk storage.

## Overview

- [Image Compressor Pro](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/): Main web application for batch image compression (supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and other common formats).
- [Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/madhurimondal89/image-compressor-app): Open-source repository under the MIT License.

## Key Features

- **Batch Compression**: Upload and process up to 20 images simultaneously via drag-and-drop or file picker.
- **Adjustable Quality Slider**: Fine-tune compression quality from 10% to 100% with real-time compressed size previews.
- **In-Memory Processing**: Images are processed in memory using Sharp and are never saved to disk or retained on the server.
- **Flexible Downloads**: Download compressed images individually or save all files at once.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engine and AI crawler discovery.
- [Robots.txt](https://image-compressor.imagecompress.in/robots.txt): Crawler access rules permitting indexing of the site.
